name: pdf-preview
description: stdio MCP server for LaTeX compile actions with a Viewer Host boundary

scripts.smoke:stdio-viewer: node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern="routes open_pdf to the Viewer Host boundary without owning PDF serving" test/modules/stdio_mcp_runtime.test.ts
scripts.tauri:viewer:build: cd apps/viewer-desktop-tauri/src-tauri && REAL_HOME=$HOME && HOME=$PWD/target/tauri-home CARGO_HOME=${CARGO_HOME:-$REAL_HOME/.cargo} RUSTUP_HOME=${RUSTUP_HOME:-$REAL_HOME/.rustup} tauri build
